lastWords:
I filled the hole with `λ p → IsMonolith.mono-least mono (⋂ 𝑨 θ) nz p i`, and `check_file` reports success on the final file (exit code 0, no holes left).

The proof works because a monolith lies below every nonzero congruence. The meet `⋂ 𝑨 θ` is nonzero by assumption, so the monolith is contained in it. Membership in that meet means being related under every `θ j`, so applying the result to `i` gives `μ ⊆ θ i`.

The check also printed two deprecation warnings from the agda-algebras library's own files, not from this one.
